deployment_mutations: REVOKE all privileges on public.concepts, public.concept_versions, public.concept_labels from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated
GRANT all privileges on the three target tables to service_role
ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on the three target tables
register migration in app_schema_migrations with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

application_deployment.purpose: route canonical resolver/search/state through ontology_concepts and ontology_aliases only

deployment_artifact_inventory.search_changes: Included in application runtime artifact; canonical search reads ontology_concepts and ontology_aliases only.
deployment_artifact_inventory.state_read_model_changes: Included in application runtime artifact; canonical Concept state reads ontology_concepts only.

credential_workaround: NONE: no secrets were extracted from logs, unrelated env files, shell history, browser storage, or other worktrees.
production_provider_state: UNKNOWN: repository supports D1 default and Supabase/PostgreSQL mode; no authorized deployment metadata or production readback is available.

deployment_dependency_graph.repository_supported_database_path: scripts/postgres-migrations.mjs with guarded single-session migration runner
deployment_dependency_graph.database_precondition: production provider must be confirmed as Supabase/PostgreSQL; 0041 does not map to D1
deployment_dependency_graph.application_precondition: merged runtime repair build must be available before traffic switch

exact_production_mutation_set.database: Only migration 0041 on the three legacy tables; no canonical or legacy row data mutation.
exact_production_mutation_set.application: Only the server knowledge query runtime repair; no mapping, seed, schema, or learner-state changes.

pre_deployment_readback_plan.connection_identity: current_database, current_user, current_schema, search_path, provider identity
pre_deployment_readback_plan.rls: pg_class.relrowsecurity and relforcerowsecurity for all three legacy tables
pre_deployment_readback_plan.grants: has_table_privilege for anon, authenticated, service_role on SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
pre_deployment_readback_plan.policies: pg_policies rows, roles, commands, USING, WITH CHECK
pre_deployment_readback_plan.canonical: read-only counts/identities for ontology_concepts, ontology_aliases, ontology_edges
pre_deployment_readback_plan.legacy: read-only table existence, counts, and migration ledger state for concepts, concept_versions, concept_labels
pre_deployment_readback_plan.client_access: supported PostgREST GET using authorized anon key and authenticated test session; no production writes
pre_deployment_readback_plan.runtime: approved existing canonical IDs/keys/aliases through the deployed server path; no synthetic production rows

production_canonical_authority: Read-only target: ontology_concepts / ontology_aliases; ontology_edges only for relation lookup.

production_rls_expected_after_deployment.concepts: RLS enabled, force false unless separately justified, anon/authenticated SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE denied, service_role retained

production_runtime_expected_after_deploy.legacy_only_synthetic_test: NOT PERFORMED in production; nonproduction proof retained

production_smoke_plan: GET public application health and database health
exercise canonical Concept resolution using approved existing ID/key/alias
exercise canonical Concept search using approved existing query
exercise relevant learning route(s) and verify no error/regression
verify auth/session boundary with anonymous and authorized sessions
capture request IDs and deployment version; do not expose service_role credentials

existing_sources: Supabase/PostgreSQL logs and advisor readback when authorized
existing audit logs for server writes
monitoring.rls_denial_anomaly: alert on unexpected 42501 volume or unexpected client 2xx access to target tables
monitoring.canonical_resolver_failure: alert on health/runtime errors and unexpected UNRESOLVED/UNKNOWN rate for approved canonical identifiers
monitoring.unexpected_legacy_access: review database/API logs for target-table access by anon/authenticated or canonical-facing service path

rollback.rls_grants: No automatic down migration. If the guarded transaction fails, transaction rollback is safe. After commit, preserve revokes and RLS; use a separately authorized forward corrective migration only. Never restore anon/authenticated privileges or disable RLS.
rollback.application_runtime: Do not roll back to the pre-repair runtime because it reads legacy tables as canonical authority. Pause traffic or roll forward to a known canonical-authority build; only a build containing the repair is an acceptable runtime rollback target.
rollback.fail_safe: If application deployment fails after DB hardening, leave legacy tables server-only and keep the database hardening active; do not declare completion until canonical runtime is serving.

security_critical_high: 0/0 repository evidence; production state not read
data_trust_critical_high: 0/0 repository evidence; production state not read
privacy_critical_high: 0/0 repository evidence; production state not read
production_decision_rationale: DEPLOYMENT_ARTIFACT_NOT_ON_MAIN takes precedence because both the RLS migration and runtime repair are local-only; CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED is an additional independent blocker.
